policy.automatic: Mutating Rust work enters rust-workflow, which chooses one primary and at most two supporting profiles. Read-only specialist reviews and verification may enter their focused skill directly.
policy.negative: A Rust keyword alone does not require a workflow for small general-knowledge questions, and non-Rust tasks must not route to this plugin.
